lead.t: A urethral stricture is fibrosis (scarring) of the urethral epithelium and the surrounding corpus spongiosum, producing a narrowing that causes resistance to the antegrade flow of urine.
lead.s: Urethral Stricture and Acute Urinary Retention

snip.t: Infection is a common complication, and partial urethral stricture may lead to urinary tract obstruction.
